sloka: तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः ।भयकारणमाचष्ट लोकानामभयङ्करः ।उवाच मधुरां वाणीं शृणुध्वं सर्वदेवताः ।। ७.६९.२४ ॥
transliteration: teṣāṁ tadvacanaṁ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ।bhayakāraṇamācaṣṭa lokānāmabhayaṅkaraḥ ।uvāca madhurāṁ vāṇīṁ śṛṇudhvaṁ sarvadevatāḥ ।। 7.69.24 ॥

translations.english: Having heard their words, Brahma, the great-grandfather and dispeller of fear for the worlds, explained the cause of their fear and spoke sweet words, asking all the gods to listen.
